title: fix(console): a refused SSO sign-in names a domain or email refusal instead of an expired link
body:
Fixes #32087

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs gain two keys under `auth.login.errors` (`ssoEmailDomainNotAllowed`, `ssoEmailNotAnAddress`) in all eleven shipped locales; no key is renamed or removed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:单点登录(SSO)拒绝建号后跳回 Console 登录页时,`EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`(邮箱不在本系统接受新账号的域名下:SSO 已验证域名规则,或 `email_domain` 受众策略的域名名单,社交注册也会落到这里)与 `INVALID_EMAIL`(身份提供方没给出可用的邮箱地址)两个错误码各有自己的一句话,说明"未创建账号"及原因,并指向组织邮箱或管理员;不再显示"登录链接已过期,请重试"。新增两个文案键,11 种语言齐全。
- 为什么改:这两种拒绝每次重试结果都一样,旧的通用文案让用户反复重试;#32087 前几项已落地,这是剩下的两个码。
- 风险与回滚:只在映射表里加两行、加两个 i18n 键,其他错误码与通用兜底不变,技术细节仍在"Technical details"折叠里。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`(两条新文案与映射行);`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx`(两条新用例);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`(英文原文)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx`,预期 14 个用例全绿,其中 `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` 的两种来源与 `INVALID_EMAIL` 各自命中新文案。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The last two items of #32087: when single sign-on refuses to create an account, the Console sign-in page now names the cause for two codes that reach real users, instead of the generic "the sign-in link expired or was already used. Please try again."

- **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`**: two rows added to `SSO_CALLBACK_REFUSALS`, the same shape as the existing per-cause rows, with the doc list extended:
  - `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` maps to `auth.login.errors.ssoEmailDomainNotAllowed`: "No account was created: your email address isn't at a domain this system accepts new accounts from. Use your organization email, or ask your administrator." Two refusals send this code to the sign-in page, and the sentence is true of both: plugin-auth `sso-account-at-proven-domain.ts` (SSO domain verification on, the email is not at a domain the provider has proven), and the `email_domain` audience posture in `audience-posture.ts` (a self-serve creation, a social sign-up included, whose email is not on the approved-domain list; better-auth's social callback redirects it to the errorURL, the console `/login`).
  - `INVALID_EMAIL` (same module, the sign-in resolved to a value that is not an email address) maps to `auth.login.errors.ssoEmailNotAnAddress`: "No account was created: your organization's sign-in service did not send a usable email address for you. Ask your administrator to check the single sign-on setup."
  - Neither sentence says "try again": both refusals repeat on every attempt, so both point the person to their administrator.
- **`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`**: the two keys in all eleven bundles, translated (the repo's convention for the sibling SSO keys). The sign-up sentence `auth.register.errors.emailDomainNotAllowed` was not reused: it says "not allowed to register here", which does not fit a sign-in.
- The technical cause (code plus the server's description) stays behind the existing details toggle; every other code keeps its sentence, and an unknown code still gets the generic one.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32087-sso-refusal-domain-and-email.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`, patch.

## Tests

`LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx` gains two rows in the existing `CASES` table of the per-cause `describe`, each with the exact `error_description` the server redirects with: the alert reads the new sentence, not the generic one, carries neither the code nor the description, and the details toggle shows `code: description`. The existing CONTROL cases (an unknown code, and a code named like an `Object.prototype` member, both keep the generic sentence) are unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- PR #33496 also edits `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` and the eleven locale files. The hunks here sit in different places (new constants before `GENERIC`, two map rows, new locale lines after `ssoResponseRejected`), and `git merge-tree` of this head with #33496's head reports no conflict; whichever lands second merges main in.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` (a report) lists the two new keys as `needs-review`, in the same class as every sibling `auth.login.errors.sso*` key: the keys are read through `RefusalCopy` objects, which the AST pass does not follow.
